Velvire opens a repair atelier in Lyon

Velvire has opened a repair atelier on rue Sainte-Catherine in Lyon, the first of five the brand plans across France.

The atelier will repair any Velvire frame, whatever its age and whoever owns it now. Frames built before the brand moved to aluminium in 2014 will be serviced by the same two mechanics who built them.

"A bike that cannot be repaired is a bike we should not have built," founder Claire Fontaine said in a statement. "Durability is not a feature we added last year. It is the reason the company exists."

The move follows a wider industry shift towards servicing, as buyers keep frames longer. Velvire, which builds outside Saint-Étienne in a workshop of eleven, sells direct and does not discount.
